# AP News: China built out record amount of wind and solar power in 2024

By Isabella O'Malley.

## Key Findings
- China installed **357 GW of solar and wind** in 2024: **45% increase** (solar) and **18% increase** (wind) over end-2023 levels.
- "Akin to building 357 full-size nuclear plants in one year."
- Surpassed goal of **1,200 GW from renewables by 2030** — **six years early**. Goal set by Xi Jinping five years prior.
- China "raced ahead building renewable energy last year, installing more wind and solar power than ever before and continuing to leave all other countries in the dust."
- Data source: China's National Energy Administration.
